pathway: Goals, support needs, and travel and money-management skills, sorted out before anyone touches an espresso machine.
Grinding, dialling in, milk texture, front-of-house: a proper course, not a token placement.
A genuine job, on the roster, at the cafe on West Terrace, not a simulation of one.

quotes.text: Before this job I'd never stood behind an espresso machine. Now it's a skill that's mine, on a team that treats me like family.
Every shift I get better behind the machine. Long-term, I'd love to run a place of my own. This feels like the start of that.

access: Wide, uncluttered pathways and a lowered counter section for wheelchair-using baristas and guests.
High-contrast, large-type signage with simple illustrations next to every item.
No rush culture here. Sit, work, chat, or just watch the machine do its thing.
